summary: A chord groovebox that recreates the workflow of the Roland J-6 on the FM-1's colour screen, with chord sets, phrase styles, a pattern sequencer and a Juno-style synth.
features: 100 chord sets; a map shows the chord on each key
9 phrase styles with 12 variations each, previewed as a piano roll
64 patterns of up to 64 steps, ties, shuffle, real-time recording
4-voice Juno-style synth, 64 sounds, chorus, delay and reverb
USB MIDI notes, clock in and out, program change; no TRS MIDI
Patterns can't be backed up yet; other firmwares may overwrite them

headings: hera: a chord groovebox for the m-vave fm-1
how it compares with the j-6
